messages:
ella: Tiny thread idea  building a 3-track mini-roadtrip soundtrack + one evening show/movie to pair. i'm packing snacks and nostalgia. i'll start.
sam: 1) Tom Petty - Free Fallin' 2) Vampire Weekend - Cape Cod Kwassa Kwassa 3) Carole King - So Far Away. Movie: Little Miss Sunshine for peak family-van energy.
dave: highway alt: 1) Pixies - Where Is My Mind? 2) Spoon - The Underdog 3) SZA - Good Days. Pair: I watch Drive at night for vibes.
nina: acoustic lane: 1) Nick Drake - Pink Moon 2) Phoebe Bridgers - Moon Song 3) José González - Heartbeats. Show: Schitt's Creek S2 for comfort.
courtney: guilty-pleasure pop: 1) Britney - Toxic 2) Hall & Oates - I Can't Go For That 3) Daft Punk - Instant Crush. Snack rec: bring cheddar popcorn. :popcorn:
ella: love the variety. small logistics note: if you're taking the company car for weekend runs, sign it out on the whiteboard in kitchen. parking spot is limited.
dj-bot: Playlist "mini-roadtrip-2789123456" created: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/roadtrip2789 (12 tracks).
sam: @nina your Nick Drake pick is perfect for sunset stops. also :+1: to the popcorn.
dave: request for @dj-bot  can it make a 45min mix from these picks for the office speaker later?
dj-bot: Auto-mix scheduled for 5pm in the kitchen speaker zone.
courtney: also tiny plant PSA  basil on the windowsill needs water if anyone's in today :herb:
ella: thanks all, this is my roadtrip caffeine. if anyone wants to add more, paste them here and i'll update the playlist. :car:
